title: Structure algebra from compatible affine spectral charts
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a sheaf of commutative O_S-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], and f : X → S a morphism of schemes. For every affine open U of S suppose given k_U : Spec A(U) → X [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume the square with top map Spec(O_S(U) → A(U)) followed by the canonical affine identification Spec O_S(U) → U, left-to-right bottom maps U → S and X → S, and remaining map k_U is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume for affine U ⊆ V that Spec(A(V) → A(U)) followed by k_V equals k_U. Then A is isomorphic as an O_S-algebra sheaf to f_* O_X. No quasi-coherence or affineness assumption on f is necessary.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 01LV, first paragraph (compatible isomorphisms of rings on affine opens extend to an algebra-sheaf isomorphism); Lemma 01LX (3). Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01LV and /tag/01LX.

proof.text: The cartesian chart square makes k_U a base change of the open inclusion U → S, hence an open immersion with image f^{-1}(U). Thus its sections map γ_U : O_X(f^{-1} U) → Γ(Spec A(U)) is invertible. In Lean, use MorphismProperty.of_isPullback, Scheme.image_preimage_eq_of_isPullback and Scheme.Hom.isIso_app. This is the open-preimage fibre-product identification [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product].

Compose γ_U with the canonical spectrum sections isomorphism Γ(Spec A(U)) → A(U) [def-weil-affine-spectrum], obtaining β_U. For U ⊆ V use Scheme.Hom.map_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE and the assumed chart compatibility to identify restriction followed by γ_U with γ_V followed by the sections map of Spec(A(V) → A(U)). Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality then proves naturality of β_U.

The affine opens form a basis. Extend β to b : f_* O_X → A using TopCat.Sheaf.restrictHomEquivHom. Its affine components are β_U by extend_hom_app, and are isomorphisms, so b is an isomorphism by TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis].

To verify algebra compatibility it suffices to check on the affine basis [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis]. Apply sections to the commuting chart square and use Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE. On global sections the inverse affine chart is U.topIso.hom followed by the inverse of ΓSpecIso O_S(U) [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Naturality of ΓSpecIso and cancellation of U.topIso and ΓSpecIso show that f-sharp followed by β_U is precisely the given algebra structure map O_S(U) → A(U). Thus b is an isomorphism in Under S.sheaf; invert it. Empty opens and zero rings require no exception.

proof_origin.place: Proof of Lemma 01LV, first paragraph; the reverse sections maps are used in Lean and inverted at the end.

lean.statement:
theorem structure_algebra_iso_of_affine_spectral_charts
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (A : S.CommAlgebraSheaf) (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S)
    (k : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, Spec (A.right.obj.obj (op U.1)) ⟶ X)
    (hk : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      IsPullback (Spec.map (A.hom.hom.app (op U.1)) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
        (k U) U.1.ι f)
    (hres : ∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ V.1),
      Spec.map (A.right.obj.map (homOfLE hUV).op) ≫ k V = k U) :
    Nonempty (A ≅ 𝒪⁎ f)
